# ring-correlation: dark ring at radius R (width ~2) minus bright halo outside
def ring(R,w=1.5):
    r=int(R+6);y,x=np.mgrid[-r:r+1,-r:r+1];d=np.hypot(x,y)
    k=np.exp(-0.5*((d-R)/w)**2)          # ring
    k-=k.mean()                           # zero mean
    k/=np.abs(k).sum()
    return k
